title: Maintenance
subtitle: Repairs, breakages, hygiene problems, low supplies and missing items
loadError: We could not load the issues. Check your connection and refresh the page.

empty.title: No issues reported
empty.body: Tap “Report an issue” for a broken tap, an AC that is not cooling, low supplies or anything missing after a checkout.

form.textPh: Where it is and what happens, e.g. Bathroom tap in 2BHK keeps dripping
form.photos: Send photos to the owner on WhatsApp if it helps.
form.reported: Reported. The owner can see it now.

resolve.title: Resolve issue
resolve.resolutionPh: e.g. Plumber replaced the tap washer
resolve.costHint: Optional. Record the payment in Expenses or Petty cash too.
resolve.chargeBody: “{name}” is added to their booking as an extra.
resolve.chargeHint: Leave empty or 0 for no charge.
resolve.fromDepositHint: Marks the deposit as deducted and the charge as paid.
resolve.overDeposit: The charge is more than the deposit, so it cannot all come from it.
resolve.platformHint: For Airbnb or Booking.com guests, also claim it through the platform’s damage or extra-cleaning process.
resolve.charged: Resolved. Charge added to the booking.

deleteBody: The report will be removed. This cannot be undone.
